# Is your campground making money, and what nightly rate do you need?

> Free profit calculator for campgrounds and RV parks: sites, months open, occupancy, nightly rate, booking commission, turnover labour with its payroll burden, and fixed costs become yearly profit, break-even occupancy and the nightly rate you need. Private, runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/campground-site-profit-calculator/)
